reason: webpack5.112.2 moved EntryDependency, breaking Taro4.3.1 internal imports. npm install retained three invalid overridden versions; npm update corrected them.
limitation: A shell working-directory error started npm update before snapshotting the old lock. Original failed reports/logs and all other then-current source files are retained. The old lock is identified by its recorded digest, not reconstructed or claimed fully reproducible. Final checks use a separately frozen complete lock.
